items.title: Professor Longhair (Henry Roeland Byrd) Interview, 1975-11-13
items.q: A drummer named John Woodrow, you don't remember him?

ctx.x: So who's John- did John Woodrow work with you, with Robert Parker? A drummer named John Woodrow, you don't remember him?
Maybe he did, maybe he didn't. I worked with so many, you know, fellas that sometimes I don't take time to learn the name because the attitude didn't add up to what-
